message.content: The conversation between Li Hua and Wolfgang Schulz revolves around the preference for the degree of doneness (medium rare or well-done) of the meat patty in a classic American cheeseburger. Wolfgang Schulz believes that well-done patties are safer and more flavorful, whereas Li Hua prefers medium rare patties due to the juicier texture he enjoys. They also discuss different burger toppings and flavors, with Wolfgang Schulz suggesting keeping it simple with classic cheese and maybe some bacon, while Li Hua leans towards adventurous options like spicy jalapeño burgers or BBQ sauce. Despite their differing opinions on the patty's degree of doneness, they seem to agree that a burger night would be enjoyable and suggest planning one in the future.
